title: ZINC1797251, a novel natural product small molecule targets viral oncoprotein E6 in human papillomavirus-16 positive cervical cancer cells.
one_liner_zh: 该文研究天然小分子靶向HPV16 E6蛋白以恢复p53功能，虽用MD模拟和虚拟筛选，但对象为蛋白-小分子互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA体系，仅方法可部分借鉴。
abstract: Cervical cancer burden due to recurrent human papillomavirus (HPV) infections necessitates the urgent need to impede viral proliferation targeting the oncogene E6 of the high-risk serotype HPV16. This study aims to identify a small molecule from a natural product library that could prevent a tumorigenic complex of E6 with p53 in HPV16-positive cervical cancer cells. In silico methods such as high-throughput virtual screening (HTVS) of natural product like library ZINC database followed by atomistic molecular dynamics (MD) simulations were performed to identify lead natural compound. This was validated with in vitro analysis using HPV16 positive SiHa cells and CaSki cells by MTT and flow cytometry assays. Virtual screening identified top 10 compounds with high affinity for HPV16 E6. The docking scores, Protein-Ligand Interaction Profiler analysis, MD simulation and molecular mechanics Poisson Boltzmann surface area-based binding energy estimation narrowed down the search to ZINC1797251, a molecule with stable binding, low energy scores and consistent H-bonds, establishing that it could prevent interaction of p53 and E6. ZINC1797251 inhibited the proliferation of SiHa and CaSki cells with a G(I50) values of 615.40 and 417.30 nM, respectively. The compound reduced HPV16 E6, while increased p53 positive populations in SiHa and CaSki cells. Treatment with ZINC1797251 induced the G(1) cell phase arrest and promoted early and late phase apoptosis in these cells. The restoration of tumor inhibitory activity of p53 in HPV-infected cervical cancer cells to promote apoptosis could be achieved using the ZINC molecule-ZINC1797251. However, further studies are deemed essential for further developments.
abstract_zh: 宫颈癌负担源于人乳头瘤病毒（HPV）的反复感染，这迫切需要通过靶向高危血清型HPV16的癌基因E6来抑制病毒增殖。本研究旨在从天然产物库中识别一种小分子，该分子能够阻止HPV16阳性宫颈癌细胞中E6与p53形成致瘤复合物。采用计算机模拟方法，如对天然产物样ZINC数据库进行高通量虚拟筛选（HTVS），随后进行原子级分子动力学（MD）模拟，以识别先导天然化合物。通过使用HPV16阳性SiHa细胞和CaSki细胞进行MTT和流式细胞术分析的体外实验验证了该结果。虚拟筛选识别出对HPV16 E6具有高亲和力的前10种化合物。对接分数、蛋白质-配体相互作用分析仪分析、MD模拟和基于分子力学泊松-玻尔兹曼表面积的结合能估算将搜索范围缩小至ZINC1797251，该分子具有稳定结合、低能量分数和一致的氢键，表明其能阻止p53与E6的相互作用。ZINC1797251抑制了SiHa和CaSki细胞的增殖，其G(I50)值分别为615.40和417.30 nM。该化合物降低了HPV16 E6，同时增加了SiHa和CaSki细胞中p53阳性群体。ZINC1797251处理诱导了这些细胞的G(1)期阻滞，并促进了早期和晚期凋亡。通过ZINC分子ZINC1797251恢复HPV感染宫颈癌细胞中p53的肿瘤抑制活性以促进凋亡是可行的。然而，进一步的研究对于后续开发被认为是必要的。
